title: Glowing kite
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- kite string -->
  <path d='M50 65 Q44 78 36 88' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- kite body - diamond shape -->
  <polygon points='50,8 75,35 50,65 25,35' fill='#FF4D6D' stroke='#FF8FA3' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- kite top panel highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,12 70,35 50,35' fill='#FF7A95'/>
  <!-- kite bottom panel -->
  <polygon points='50,38 70,35 50,62' fill='#E03050'/>
  <!-- kite left panel -->
  <polygon points='25,35 50,38 50,62' fill='#C42040'/>
  <!-- cross spar lines -->
  <line x1='50' y1='8' x2='50' y2='65' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='25' y1='35' x2='75' y2='35' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- glowing center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='4' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='8' fill='#FFE066' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- tail ribbon -->
  <path d='M50 65 Q55 72 50 78 Q45 84 50 90' stroke='#FF8FA3' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail bows -->
  <polygon points='55,72 60,69 60,75' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <polygon points='45,84 40,81 40,87' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='20' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='18' r='1.5' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='45' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
</svg>
